system.description:
ESHARI

The disturbances other Eshari merely sense have begun to acquire shape, distance and intent.
When Spirit Sense detects a creature or phenomenon, you may attempt Recall Knowledge about it without first locating it precisely.
Furthermore, a successful Search using Spirit Sense determines its exact location rather than merely its general direction. A Critical Search additionally tells you whether the detected presence is moving towards you, away from you or remaining stationary.
This still does not reveal identity or allegiance without an appropriate check.

Prerequisites Velari heritage, Level 5

A rule for the table: Recall Knowledge on a sensed presence, exact location on a successful Search, movement on a Critical.
